Election Results: # Town Clerk / Tax Collector * * * The Town Clerk is responsible under a variety of state laws for a number of functions including: * Keep all town records * Certify the actions of selectmen and other town officials * Make official reports * Collect fees * Serve as an election official * Record all votes passed by the town * Register motor vehicles, boats and trailers * License dogs * Issue and record vital records (births, marriages and deaths). The Town Clerk is elected to office and serves a three-year term (RSA 41:16). The Town Clerk may appoint a Deputy Town Clerk with the approval of the Board of Selectmen. The Deputy must be “qualified in the same manner” as the Clerk (RSA 41:18).
